# Form layout crushes inputs beside wide labels and on its tile

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for immediate Engine 14 pre-cut delivery (`2026-11-23`), promoting `@neo-opus-ada`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:82094302-55fa-4639-8cd0-257de7d2df62`) and `@neo-gemini-maryam`'s `#21329` blind cold-look finding (`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABpndOsw`); curated contributor labels omitted because the Engine 14 lock is within hours.

## Context

On `dev`, the published `Form layout` tile (`devmode/tiles/layout-form-14.jpg`, cross-listed on both `Containers & Layouts` and `Forms & Fields`) renders the outer form's two inputs (`"This is a wide Label inside Form"`, `"Small Label"`) as `0 px` vertical slivers and the nested fieldset's two inputs at `~45 px` (`"Lay…"`). Measuring `examples/layout/form/index.html` in headless Chromium across desktop (`1440 × 900`), mobile (`390 × 844`), and the tile capture width (`240 × 150`) isolates both an Engine `Neo.layout.Form` CSS defect and an undersized tile override:

| Viewport / Capture Box | Form Width | Outer Label Width | Outer `.neo-input-wrapper` | Fieldset `.neo-input-wrapper` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `1440 × 900` stage (`dev`) | `457.8 px` | `228.8 px` | `181.0 px` | `202.9 px` |
| `390 × 844` phone stage (`dev`) | `328.0 px` | `228.8 px` | **`51.2 px`** (`~27 px` text) | **`73.1 px`** (`~49 px` text) |
| `captureExamples.json` (`240 × 150`) | `240.0 px` | `228.8 px` | **`0 px` sliver** | **`~45 px`** (`"Lay…"`) |

## The Problem

1. **`Neo.layout.Form` crushes inputs beside wide labels on narrow stages:** `resources/css/src/layout/Form.css` defines `grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr`, while `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:4,7` gives `.neo-textfield` a fixed `27 px` single-line height and `white-space: nowrap`. In any narrow container (`390 × 844` phone stage or a compact panel/dialog), column 1 (`max-content`) refuses to wrap and consumes almost the entire width, crushing `.neo-input-wrapper` (`flex: 1 1 1px; overflow: hidden`) down to `0–51 px`.
2. **Two selector gaps in `Form.css`:**
   - `Form.css:17-19` places only `.neo-input-wrapper` in `grid-column: 2 / 3`, omitting bare `.neo-textfield-input` (rendered when `clearable: false` / no triggers); when `hideLabel: true`, a triggerless input falls into column `1 / 2`.
   - `Form.css:24` targets `.legend` instead of `.neo-layout-form-legend` (stamped by `src/layout/Form.mjs:61` since `#19920` / `#19923`), and omits `min-width: 0` on `.neo-layout-form-subfieldset` to override the browser UA `<fieldset> { min-width: min-content }` floor.
3. **Undersized tile override & missing theme wiring on `examples/layout/form`:** `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json:20` forces `{"path": "examples/layout/form", "width": 240, "height": 150}` onto a four-field nested-fieldset form (`224 px` tall), and `examples/layout/form/{app.mjs,neo-config.json}` omits `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)` and `neo-theme-neo-dark` / `neo-theme-neo-light`, ignoring `?theme=` when launched from the Portal.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/layout/Form.css:1-27` — CSS Grid + `subgrid` rules for `.neo-layout-form`, `.neo-layout-form-item`, `.neo-layout-form-subfieldset`, and legend items.
- `src/layout/Form.mjs:56-66` — stamps `neo-layout-form-legend`, `neo-layout-form-subfieldset`, and `neo-layout-form-item` onto child `wrapperCls`.
- `examples/layout/form/{MainContainer.mjs,app.mjs,neo-config.json}` & `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json:20` — workbench entry and tile capture sizing (`catalogTiles()` in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs:141-161` already derives component tiles at their own size from `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/layouts.json`).
- Design authority: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/layouts.json:22-23` (*"A form composed by the layout-form layout with shared itemDefaults — Note both fields share the clearable textfield defaults while their labels differ in length"*) and `src/layout/Form.mjs:58-64` (`#19920` / `#19923`).

## The Fix

*(Prescription checked: `resources/css/src/layout/Form.css`, `examples/layout/form/{MainContainer.mjs,app.mjs,neo-config.json}`, and `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` — own the concern.)*

1. In `resources/css/src/layout/Form.css`:
   - Change `.neo-layout-form` to `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, max-content) minmax(8rem, 1fr)` so wide containers still align column 1 at single-line `max-content` while narrow containers preserve at least `8rem` (`128 px`) for the input column and let long labels wrap cleanly.
   - Give `& > .neo-layout-form-item` `align-items: center; height: auto; min-height: calc(var(--textfield-input-height) + var(--textfield-border-width) * 2)`, allow `.neo-textfield-label` to wrap (`white-space: normal`), place both `.neo-input-wrapper`, `.neo-textfield-input`, `.neo-textfield-character-count`, and `.neo-textfield-error-wrapper` in `grid-column: 2 / 3` with `min-width: 0`, and replace `.legend` with `& > .neo-layout-form-legend` plus `min-width: 0` on `& > .neo-layout-form-subfieldset`.
   - Rebuild theme CSS via `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`.
2. In `examples/layout/form/{MainContainer.mjs,app.mjs,neo-config.json}` and `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json`:
   - Wire `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)` in `app.mjs`, add the four themes (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`) in `neo-config.json`, set `componentName: 'Form layout'` and `style: {maxWidth: '100%', width: '420px'}` on the example `Form`, and remove the `{"path": "examples/layout/form", "width": 240, "height": 150}` override from `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` so `catalogTiles()` captures the form at its natural size.
3. Recapture `devmode/tiles/layout-form-14.jpg` and `devmode/tiles/layout-form-14-light.jpg` via `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --tile examples/layout/form` and ship the companion `neomjs/pages` PR (`--base main`).
4. Add browser component/E2E assertions covering narrow-container label wrapping + `>= 120 px` input width, triggerless `hideLabel: true` column-2 placement, `.neo-layout-form-legend` full-row span, and `examples/layout/form` `?theme=` + `1440 × 900` / `390 × 844` geometry.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resources/css/src/layout/Form.css` (`.neo-layout-form`) | `src/layout/Form.mjs:58-64`, `layouts.json:22-23` | `minmax(0, max-content) minmax(8rem, 1fr)` columns; wrapped labels on narrow widths; `.neo-input-wrapper` & `.neo-textfield-input` in col `2 / 3`; `& > .neo-layout-form-legend` & `subfieldset` span `1 / 3` with `min-width: 0` | Single-line `max-content` label alignment whenever container width fits `max-content + gap + 8rem` | CSS comments + JSDoc on `Form.mjs` | Component/E2E browser spec at `240 px`, `390 × 844`, and `1440 × 900` |
| `examples/layout/form` & `captureExamples.json` | `#21908` / `#21997`, `src/util/Theme.mjs` | Honors `?theme=` across Neo Dark/Light; captured at natural `420 px` (`maxWidth: '100%'`) form width without `240 × 150` override | Falls back to `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)` | Example JSDoc | `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` + `LayoutTiles.spec.mjs` + `neomjs/pages` tile pair |

## Decision Record impact

`none`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In `Neo.layout.Form`, text fields inside narrow containers (`240–328 px`, including `390 × 844` mobile stage) keep an input box at least `120 px` wide while wide labels wrap without vertical row overlap, and wide desktop containers keep single-line `max-content` label alignment.
- [ ] AC-2: A triggerless `Neo.form.field.Text` (`clearable: false`, `hideLabel: true`) inside `Neo.layout.Form` places `.neo-textfield-input` in column `2 / 3`, and a `Neo.component.Legend` child spans `1 / 3` via `.neo-layout-form-legend`.
- [ ] AC-3: `examples/layout/form` honors `?theme=` (`neo-theme-neo-dark` / `neo-theme-neo-light`), has `0 px` horizontal overflow at `390 × 844`, and `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` drops the `240 × 150` `examples/layout/form` override.
- [ ] AC-4: `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`, unit specs (`Form.spec.mjs`, `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`), and a headless-Chromium spec (recorded red on `dev` and green at head) pass.
- [ ] AC-5: Fresh dark and light `devmode/tiles/layout-form-14*.jpg` tiles are captured via `captureExamples.mjs --tile examples/layout/form` and opened as a companion PR on `neomjs/pages`, with `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` stage screenshots attached on the Engine PR.

## Out of Scope

- Portal catalog lead-card aspect-ratio rules in `List.css` (tracked separately under `#21140` / `#21329`).
- Unmodified pre-freeze tile size entries in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json` (`#22006` tracks `tree` / `treeAccordion` post-cut).

## Avoided Traps

- Fixing only `captureExamples.json` while leaving `Form.css` at `max-content 1fr` with `white-space: nowrap`, which leaves `examples/layout/form` crushed to `51 px` inputs (`~27 px` visible text) on `390 × 844` phones and breaks narrow `layout-form` containers across the engine.
- Touching generated `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (`buildScripts/release/prepare.mjs` owns cut-time regeneration per `#21856`).
